scriptData.label: @effect.name

description.label: Description
description.value:
The bullet smashes into your shoulder blade. The projectile flattens and then shatters against the bone, the pieces tearing a ragged shallow crater as they spread outward from the impact and strip the shoulder blade of flesh and muscle. Grisly!

Effects: Gain @Condition[Stunned] (1) and @Condition[Bleeding] (2). You suffer a @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.qn4ZpvTQIX4rcJDl]{Torn Muscle (Major)}.

Surgery (Average) is required for Extraction of the bullet fragments still remaining in the wound.
